text.en: Instead of a gift, a father sends his daughter a letter full of thoughts.

Jawaharlal Nehru, India's first Prime Minister, wrote letters to his young daughter Indira while he was in prison. In this birthday letter he says that real gifts are not just things bought with money but good thoughts and wishes. He encourages her to be brave and good and to serve India.
The letter shows his warmth as a father and teacher. It teaches that courage and goodness matter more than possessions.
Learn letter-writing features: address, date, greeting, body and closing. Words to note: tutelage, architect, sovereign and eminent.
